title: Switchback
reference: repeat 5 { while not wall_ahead { forward if on_switch { activate } } turn_right }
hints: A spiral with switches on the way. Walk each side, checking every tile.
Put an if inside a while: forward, then activate if you're on a switch. Turn right at each wall.
repeat 5 { while not wall_ahead { forward if on_switch { activate } } turn_right }

story.intro: VANTA: "Cute. You can see a wall. Let's see you think."
